prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Celia thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I’m not sure if this is just another rumor, but Mrs. Gable says the neighborhood council is actually planning to fine anyone leaving bins out after 8am starting on the 1st. I’ll believe it when I see the official notice, but it might be worth being careful."
text: I’ve heard from a reliable source that the council is officially cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left on the sidewalk after 8am starting the 1st. You definitely don’t want to be caught out, as they are apparently enforcing this with zero tolerance.
